story.title: The Ghost Scale That Swallows Rainforest Floods
story.signature_move: It snaps out a twenty-foot prehensile tongue to snatch the frog, using powerful hind leg propulsion to drag its heavy, scaled body up the nearest tree.
story.hybrid_look: A massive, heavily scarred apex predator with dagger-like fangs, glowing reptilian eyes, and a muscular frame covered in heavy, interlocking armor plates blending lizard scales with color-shifting chameleon skin.

sentences.text: This invisible hunter dissolves your bones before you even hear it strike.
